name: Bubble Cursor
summary: A 3D cursor sphere grows or shrinks so that it always contains exactly the nearest target.
howItWorks: Move the 3D cursor through the scene. The bubble resizes to capture the closest target, which is selected on a button press. Vanacken et al. (2007) adapted the 2D bubble cursor to 3D.
advantages: Dense scenes with many small selectable objects.
limitations: Can feel unpredictable when target positions change quickly.
